uncertainties: LOM cell ('Lombardy & Veneto', seed near Brescia) assigned to Venice throughout: most of the cell was Venetian terraferma and Venice city is its capital. The Duchy of Milan (Sforza to 1535, then Spanish) therefore renders only via notes/events, not as a region holder. Milan city itself sits on the LOM/PIE cell boundary.

PIE cell covers Piedmont, Liguria and western Lombardy: assigned to Savoy (Genoa and Milan share it), and to France 1536-59 during the occupation of Savoy-Piedmont. Genoa renders only through Corsica (COR).

SAX_L (Lower Saxony & Westphalia) kept as a generic 'Holy Roman Empire' entity for the fragmented Guelph/episcopal/Hanseatic north; likewise RHE = Palatinate and FRK = Hesse stand in for crowded imperial neighborhoods.
Silesia (SIL) assigned to Bohemia in every slice: a Bohemian Crown land from 1335, Habsburg from 1526 — not Polish in this period.

North African presidios (Spanish Oran & Melilla, Portuguese Tangier/Ceuta, Spanish Tripoli 1510-30, La Goletta 1535-74) are city-scale and do not drive cell assignment; ORA is Zayyanid Tlemcen until absorbed by Ottoman Algiers (1556), TUN stays Hafsid-under-Spanish-protection until assigned Ottoman from 1571 (Uluc Ali took Tunis 1569; definitive 1574).

Hungary 1526: HUN kept under Zápolya's kingdom (crowned Nov 1526) since the Ottomans withdrew after Mohács; Ottoman annexation of central Hungary shown from the 1541 fall of Buda (1556 slice onward). SVK given to Ferdinand already in 1526 to show the Habsburg west.

Livonian War mid-phases simplified: Russian-held Narva/Dorpat (1558-81) noted but EST assigned to Sweden and LVA to Poland-Lithuania from 1571 as the treaty-confirmed holders (Vilnius 1561, Yam-Zapolsky 1582, Plussa 1583).
RUS_C assigned to Poland-Lithuania in 1610 (contested): the Kremlin garrison under Żółkiewski/Gosiewski ruled through the Seven Boyars for Władysław — an occupation, not an annexation; expelled 1612.

GEO in 1598 left with the Georgian kingdoms (contested) although the 1590 Treaty of Constantinople gave the Caucasus to the Porte — Ottoman control ran through garrisons and tributary kings rather than provincial administration.
UKR_E and STE given to Crimean Tatars until the 1550s, then to an emerging Zaporozhian Cossack tribal entity (Sich c. 1552); both were thinly settled 'wild fields' with no clean sovereign.
KAR (East Karelia) kept Russian throughout (Novgorodian inheritance); Swedish Kexholm cession (1609-11) noted but not flipped since the fortress fell only in 1611.
Population figures follow McEvedy & Jones orders of magnitude, interpolated: Europe roughly 60M (1512) to 78M (1610); Ottoman totals include Asian/African provinces (extendsBeyondMap).
Aegean AEG assigned to Venice until the annexation of the Duchy of Naxos (1566), Ottoman from the 1571 slice; individual Latin islet lordships ignored.

Ireland: kept as a Gaelic/Anglo-Irish tribal entity through 1598 (Crown control limited to the Pale and towns; Yellow Ford 1598), flipped wholly to England for 1610 after the 1603 conquest and the Ulster Plantation.
